Class TeamCityStatistics

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.TeamCityStatistics
public final class TeamCityStatistics extends Object
Hands the session's measures to TeamCity as build statistics (ike-issues#1207).

TeamCity reads ##teamcity[buildStatisticValue …] service messages from a build's output and keeps each key's value with the build, which is what its charts, its "fail build on metric change" conditions and its REST API then read. Coverage is also reported under the keys TeamCity reserves for it, so the server's own coverage views and conditions see the same numbers. The extension prints only when "TEAMCITY_VERSION" is set, which every TeamCity build step has; a local build prints nothing.

    • processOutput

      public static PrintStream processOutput()
      Opens the process's own standard output, which TeamCity reads.

      Not System.out: Maven 4 replaces that stream and relays whatever a plugin or extension writes to it through its logger as [INFO] [stdout] …, and a service message that does not start its line is not one to TeamCity. Writing to the file descriptor itself goes past the relay. The stream is never closed, since closing it would close the process's output.

      Returns:
      a line-flushing stream on file descriptor 1
